scope: Florida I-4 corridor: Tampa, Plant City, Lakeland, Orlando, Sanford, DeLand, Daytona Beach (Hillsborough, Polk, Osceola, Orange, Seminole, Volusia)
method: WebSearch only. WebFetch and direct HTTP were blocked in this environment, so facts come from search-result snippets and need spot-checking. null = unconfirmed.
key_takeaways: Healthcare is the biggest vertical driver: more than $3B in active or announced towers and hospitals (AdventHealth, Orlando Health, TGH, BayCare, LRH). Robins & Morton, Brasfield & Gorrie, Skanska and Gilbane hold much of it.
Aviation and sports megaprojects: TPA Airside D (Hensel Phelps), USF stadium (Manhattan), Rays ballpark (financing approved Aug 2026, GC TBD), MCO Terminal C phase 2 planning.
Polk County industrial and data centers: Lakeland Central Park, CFILP (Chick-fil-A, PepsiCo), Fort Meade/Cielo data-center proposals. Local industrial GCs include Marcobay and Frampton.
Public schools are mostly renovations and continuing-service CM pools (Volusia, Seminole). OCPS is pausing new campuses until about 2031.
Multifamily remains large in Orlando (~11k-17k units underway) and Tampa (Gasworx, Water Street area).
